{{Quote|One of my hunters has gotten himself into a bit of a pickle, I'm afraid. While exploring what he thought was an abandoned tusk-cat den, he uncovered a nest of nightspiders.|[[Sloan Rusper]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LSR">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Lord Sloan Rusper|Rori}}</ref>}}
The '''nightspider''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of large, predatory [[Spider/Legends|spider]] that could be found on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Biology and appearance==
Nightspiders were large arachnids native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. They were known to use a deadly poison to kill prey or defend themselves. At least one strain, the '''Poison Spitter''', could shoot its poison at a target. The '''King Venom Nightspider''' was the most aggressive and deadliest of all subspecies.<ref name="SWG" />

Nightspiders were likely related to [[hermit spider]]s, another arachnid species from Naboo.<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
{{Quote|I've been given my first assignment as an RSF Agent. It's not glorious, but it's a start. I'm to reduce the nightspider population around Kaadara.|[[Jonni Skaak|Jonthol Mazoon]]|<ref name="SWG:TLaDoJS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Life and Death of Jonni Skaak|Naboo}}</ref>}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] working for [[Sloan Rusper]] discovered a nest of nightspiders while investigating an abandoned [[tusk cat]] den near [[Restuss]]. The hunter was then rescued by a spacer who killed two nightspider aggressors.<ref name="SWG:LSR" />

During his career in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], [[Jonni Skaak|Jonthol Mazoon]] was tasked to reduce the nightspider population around the city of [[Kaadara]] and eliminate the giant nightspider [[Noctur'lan]].<ref name="SWG:TLaDoJS" /> In 1 ABY,<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> a spacer was tasked by RSF [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Karenna Dunnels|Dunnels]] to kill nightspiders and collect their venom sacs in order to produce a batch of [[Stimulant|neural boosters]].<ref name="SWG:HLDwitmNB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Help Lt. Dunnels with ingredients to make Neural Boosters|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Nightspider_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art for ''Star Wars Galaxies''.]]
Nightspiders appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, nightspiders were virtually identical to hermit spiders but no explicit relationship was established between the two species.<ref name="SWG" />
